title: Add your products for shops to sell
intro: Welcome to Shopinbos for suppliers. In one minute, you'll add a product that shops across Nigeria can sell.

steps.caption: Tap Add product
steps.vo: On your Home screen, tap Add product.

steps.caption: Take a photo of it
steps.vo: Take a photo of your product, or choose one from your gallery. Use a clear photo on a plain background, because shops use it on their stores.

steps.caption: Name, prices and stock
steps.vo: Give it a name. Add your price for one, for dropship orders, and your wholesale price for twenty or more. Then say how many you have.

steps.caption: Retail price and details
steps.vo: Add a suggested retail price. Shops add their own margin on top of your wholesale price. Describe it, then pick what kind of product it is.

steps.caption: Save: we check it first
steps.vo: Tap Save. We check it first, usually within a day. It shows on your Products page as In review, and we'll tell you when a shop adds it.

outro: That's it. Next, learn how to handle orders from shops.
